title: "Fine-tuning strategy comparison"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
source(file.path(repo_root, "visualization_github", "visualization_config.R"))
config <- visualization_config(repo_root, "finetune_strategy_comparison")
base_dir <- config$results_root
implemented_mse_name <- if (config$mode == "simulated") {
  "results_11_dim8"
} else {
  "results_5_dim8"
}
implemented_mse_pattern <- if (config$mode == "simulated") {
  "^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)lambda_len100$"
} else {
  "^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)$"
}
implemented_mse_dir <- file.path(base_dir, implemented_mse_name)
global_mse_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_finetune_new8")
implemented_time_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_11_dim8")
global_time_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_finetune_new_time8")
# "Implemented with More Parameters" reuses test_PLM.R with lambda_length=200
# instead of 100. It writes into the same results_11_dim8 tree as the
# regular Implemented method, distinguished only by the "lambda_len200"
# settings-folder suffix.
more_parameters_mse_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_11_dim8")
more_parameters_time_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_11_dim8")
derived_dir <- config$derived_dir
figure_dir <- config$figure_dir
dir.create(derived_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

required_dirs <- c(
  implemented_mse_dir, global_mse_dir,
  implemented_time_dir, global_time_dir
)
missing_dirs <- required_dirs[!dir.exists(required_dirs)]
if (length(missing_dirs)) {
  stop("Missing required result directories: ", paste(missing_dirs, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

keep_similarity <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)
# Short labels used consistently in both the MSE and Time panels, and a
# shared color per method so the same method is the same color everywhere.
implemented_label <- "Implemented"
global_label <- "Global Fine-tuned"
more_parameters_label <- "Implemented with More Parameters"
method_levels <- c(global_label, implemented_label, more_parameters_label)
method_colors <- c(
  "Global Fine-tuned" = "#F8766D",
  "Implemented" = "#00BA38",
  "Implemented with More Parameters" = "#619CFF"
)
custom_labeller <- labeller(
  n = function(value) paste0("n = ", value),
  similarity = function(value) value
)

extract_seed <- function(path, prefix) {
  pattern <- paste0("^", prefix, "_([0-9]+).*$")
  as.integer(sub(pattern, "\\1", basename(path)))
}

read_mse_collection <- function(root, setting_pattern, method_label) {
  files <- list.files(
    root,
    pattern = "^mse_data_seed_[0-9]+[.]rds$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  rows <- lapply(files, function(path) {
    setting <- basename(dirname(path))
    parts <- regmatches(setting, regexec(setting_pattern, setting, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(parts) != 3L) return(NULL)

    value <- readRDS(path)
    task_columns <- grep("^Task[0-9]+$", names(value), value = TRUE)
    method_row <- match("NonPara_Transfer_Tuned", rownames(value))
    if (!length(task_columns) || is.na(method_row)) {
      stop("Expected NonPara_Transfer_Tuned task results in ", path, call. = FALSE)
    }
    task_mse <- as.numeric(value[method_row, task_columns, drop = TRUE])
    data.frame(
      seed = extract_seed(path, "mse_data_seed"),
      n = as.integer(parts[[2]]),
      similarity = as.numeric(parts[[3]]),
      Method = method_label,
      mean_mse = mean(task_mse, na.rm = TRUE),
      maximum_mse = max(task_mse, na.rm = TRUE),
      source_file = file.path(basename(root), setting, basename(path)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) stop("No matching MSE files found in ", root, call. = FALSE)
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  result[is.finite(result$mean_mse) & is.finite(result$maximum_mse), ]
}

read_runtime_collection <- function(root, file_pattern, setting_pattern,
                                    runtime_column, method_label) {
  files <- list.files(
    root,
    pattern = file_pattern,
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  rows <- lapply(files, function(path) {
    setting <- basename(dirname(path))
    parts <- regmatches(setting, regexec(setting_pattern, setting, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(parts) != 3L) return(NULL)

    value <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!runtime_column %in% names(value)) {
      stop("Missing ", runtime_column, " in ", path, call. = FALSE)
    }
    prefix <- if (grepl("^time_seed", basename(path))) "time_seed" else "time_data_seed"
    data.frame(
      seed = extract_seed(path, prefix),
      n = as.integer(parts[[2]]),
      similarity = as.numeric(parts[[3]]),
      Method = method_label,
      runtime_minutes = as.numeric(value[[runtime_column]][[1]]) / 60,
      source_file = file.path(basename(root), setting, basename(path)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) stop("No matching runtime files found in ", root, call. = FALSE)
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  result[is.finite(result$runtime_minutes) & result$runtime_minutes > 0, ]
}

empty_mse <- function() {
  data.frame(seed = integer(), n = integer(), similarity = numeric(),
             Method = character(), mean_mse = numeric(), maximum_mse = numeric(),
             source_file = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
empty_runtime <- function() {
  data.frame(seed = integer(), n = integer(), similarity = numeric(),
             Method = character(), runtime_minutes = numeric(),
             source_file = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# "Implemented with More Parameters" (lambda_length=200) is a simulation run
# in progress at the time this was written. Its collector returns an empty
# (not missing/fabricated) data frame if no matching files exist yet, rather
# than failing the whole render -- the other two series still render while
# this one is incomplete.
read_mse_collection_optional <- function(root, setting_pattern, method_label) {
  tryCatch(
    read_mse_collection(root, setting_pattern, method_label),
    error = function(e) empty_mse()
  )
}
read_runtime_collection_optional <- function(root, file_pattern, setting_pattern,
                                             runtime_column, method_label) {
  tryCatch(
    read_runtime_collection(root, file_pattern, setting_pattern, runtime_column, method_label),
    error = function(e) empty_runtime()
  )
}
```

## MSE inputs

```{r load-mse}
implemented_mse <- read_mse_collection(
  implemented_mse_dir,
  implemented_mse_pattern,
  implemented_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

global_mse <- read_mse_collection(
  global_mse_dir,
  "^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)$",
  global_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

more_parameters_mse <- read_mse_collection_optional(
  more_parameters_mse_dir,
  "^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)lambda_len200$",
  more_parameters_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

write.csv(implemented_mse, file.path(derived_dir, "implemented_mse_by_seed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(global_mse, file.path(derived_dir, "global_finetuned_mse_by_seed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(more_parameters_mse, file.path(derived_dir, "more_parameters_mse_by_seed.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

data.frame(
  Method = c(global_label, implemented_label, more_parameters_label),
  Available_records = c(nrow(global_mse), nrow(implemented_mse), nrow(more_parameters_mse)),
  Input = c(
    file.path(basename(base_dir), "results_finetune_new8"),
    file.path(basename(base_dir), implemented_mse_name),
    file.path(basename(base_dir), "results_11_dim8 (lambda_len200)")
  )
)
```

## Implemented-method mean MSE

```{r implemented-mse-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
p_implemented_mse <- ggplot(implemented_mse, aes(Method, mean_mse, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean MSE") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

## Fine-tuning method comparison

`results_finetune_new8` (the Global Fine-tuned source) historically has only
10 legacy seeds at n=200, far fewer than Implemented/More-Parameters' 100.
At n=200, Implemented and More-Parameters are therefore restricted to the
`(n, similarity, seed)` combinations that actually exist for Global, so no
method gets extra replications merely because more files exist for it. At
n=100, Global now has its own up-to-100-seed run (no 10-seed legacy
restriction applies), so all three series are combined directly with no
subsetting.

```{r mse-comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
global_mse_200 <- global_mse %>% filter(n == 200)
common_mse_keys_200 <- global_mse_200 %>% select(seed, n, similarity) %>% distinct()
implemented_mse_200 <- implemented_mse %>%
  filter(n == 200) %>%
  inner_join(common_mse_keys_200, by = c("seed", "n", "similarity"))
more_parameters_mse_200 <- more_parameters_mse %>%
  filter(n == 200) %>%
  inner_join(common_mse_keys_200, by = c("seed", "n", "similarity"))
if (!nrow(implemented_mse_200)) {
  stop("No common n=200 MSE settings exist between implemented and fine-tuned results.")
}

mse_comparison <- bind_rows(
  global_mse_200, implemented_mse_200, more_parameters_mse_200,
  global_mse %>% filter(n == 100),
  implemented_mse %>% filter(n == 100),
  more_parameters_mse %>% filter(n == 100)
) %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = method_levels))
write.csv(mse_comparison,
          file.path(derived_dir, "finetune_method_comparison_by_seed.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

p_mse_comparison <- ggplot(mse_comparison, aes(Method, mean_mse, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean MSE", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
# Not saved: this component plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "finetune_method_comparison.pdf"), p_mse_comparison,
#        width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
p_mse_comparison
```

## Runtime inputs

```{r load-runtime}
global_runtime <- read_runtime_collection(
  global_time_dir,
  "^time_seed_[0-9]+[.]csv$",
  "^mse_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)$",
  "runtime_sec",
  global_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

implemented_runtime <- read_runtime_collection(
  implemented_time_dir,
  "^time_data_seed_[0-9]+[.]csv$",
  "^_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)lambda_len100$",
  "time_nonpar_transfer",
  implemented_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

more_parameters_runtime <- read_runtime_collection_optional(
  more_parameters_time_dir,
  "^time_data_seed_[0-9]+[.]csv$",
  "^_n_([0-9]+)_simi_([0-9.]+)lambda_len200$",
  "time_nonpar_transfer",
  more_parameters_label
) %>%
  filter(round(similarity, 1) %in% keep_similarity)

# Same n=200 common-seed restriction as the MSE comparison above (Global has
# only 10 legacy seeds at n=200); n=100 combines all available data directly.
global_runtime_200 <- global_runtime %>% filter(n == 200)
common_runtime_keys_200 <- global_runtime_200 %>% select(seed, n, similarity) %>% distinct()
implemented_runtime_200 <- implemented_runtime %>%
  filter(n == 200) %>%
  inner_join(common_runtime_keys_200, by = c("seed", "n", "similarity"))
more_parameters_runtime_200 <- more_parameters_runtime %>%
  filter(n == 200) %>%
  inner_join(common_runtime_keys_200, by = c("seed", "n", "similarity"))
if (!nrow(implemented_runtime_200)) {
  stop("No common n=200 runtime settings exist between implemented and fine-tuned results.")
}

runtime_comparison <- bind_rows(
  global_runtime_200, implemented_runtime_200, more_parameters_runtime_200,
  global_runtime %>% filter(n == 100),
  implemented_runtime %>% filter(n == 100),
  more_parameters_runtime %>% filter(n == 100)
) %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = method_levels))
write.csv(runtime_comparison,
          file.path(derived_dir, "runtime_comparison_by_seed.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r runtime-boxplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
p_runtime_box <- ggplot(runtime_comparison,
                        aes(Method, runtime_minutes, fill = Method)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, coef = 2, width = 0.65) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time (minutes)", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16), legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
# Not saved: this component plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "runtime_boxplot.pdf"), p_runtime_box,
#        width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
p_runtime_box
```

```{r runtime-barplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
runtime_summary <- runtime_comparison %>%
  group_by(Method, n, similarity) %>%
  summarise(
    q1 = quantile(runtime_minutes, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3 = quantile(runtime_minutes, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(runtime_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum = min(runtime_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = max(runtime_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = pmax(minimum, q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1)),
    upper = pmin(maximum, q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1))
  )

p_runtime_bar <- ggplot(runtime_summary, aes(Method, median, fill = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(n ~ similarity, labeller = custom_labeller, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time (minutes)", fill = "Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
# Not saved: this component plot is retained in the HTML only.
# ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "runtime_barplot.pdf"), p_runtime_bar,
#        width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
p_runtime_bar
```

## Combined comparison

A single shared "Method" legend (same colors/names in both panels) replaces
the separate per-panel legends.

```{r combined-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
legend_source <- p_mse_comparison +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13))
shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_source)

combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_mse_comparison, p_runtime_bar, shared_legend,
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1, 0.12)
)
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "tuning_strategy_compare.pdf"), combined,
       width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300)
combined
```
